added.description:
Our Engineering organisation is scaling its AI Engineering capabilities under new leadership, creating an opportunity to build the next generation of AI at Rapid7. We’re looking for Principal AI Engineers to join us and help shape what comes next by defining and influencing the technical direction of our LLM and agentic AI systems. As a Principal AI Engineer, you’ll raise the bar for engineering standards, and build truly cutting edge greenfield solutions that deliver real impact for our Global customers. Through your technical leadership and mentoring, you’ll help shape our product and platform investments and influence how we build and scale AI across the organisation.

About The Team

AI is reshaping cybersecurity on both sides. Attackers can use AI to strike at machine speed, and only AI-powered defense can keep up. At the same time, organizations can only adopt AI with confidence if it is secure. Rapid7 sits at the intersection of security and AI, and we are building industry-defining products for this new era.

Rapid7's AI Engineering team builds the AI that powers our security platform. We are AI engineers and applied scientists who take models from research to production, combining open-source and frontier LLMs, AI agents, and fast predictive models with more than 20 years of Rapid7 security expertise. Our work drives core use cases across Detection and Response, such as alert triage, threat investigation, and automated response, and Exposure and Remediation, such as vulnerability prioritization, attack surface risk assessment, and guided remediation. Together, these help customers stop threats faster and fix what matters most.

About The Role

As a Principal AI Engineer, you will set the technical direction for how Rapid7 builds, tunes and serves LLMs and agentic systems across its security products. You understand LLMs from the ground up, from transformer internals and training to fine-tuning and inference optimization, and you stay hands-on with the hardest problems. You know where LLMs shine and where they fall short, and you treat them as one tool in the AI toolbox, alongside predictive AI and classical ML, choosing the right approach for each problem. Specifically your focus will be to:

Define the architecture and technical roadmap for LLM and agentic AI systems across Detection and Response and Exposure and Remediation
Lead model strategy: when to use frontier or open-source models, and when to fine-tune, distill, or post-train
Fine-tune, distill and post-train open-source LLMs on security data, from data curation through training, evaluation and deployment
Set engineering standards for context engineering, inference optimization, and evaluation across teams
Optimize LLM inference at scale with techniques such as speculative decoding, KV-cache management, continuous batching, quantization and custom kernels, balancing quality, latency and cost
Establish evals as the release gate for every AI system we ship
Lead design reviews and resolve the hardest technical trade-offs
Stay hands-on: prototype and build critical model, training and inference code yourself
Mentor Staff and Senior engineers and shape product and platform investment

The Skills And Qualities You’ll Bring Include

12+ years of software or ML engineering experience, including 2+ years building production LLM or agentic AI systems. A PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI or a related field is preferred, or equivalent depth of expertise demonstrated through industry experience and technical contributions
A track record of building scalable, production-grade AI systems used across multiple teams or products with a strong history of organization-wide impact through technical leadership, mentoring, and shared platforms and standards
LLMs from first principles: deep understanding of transformer architecture, attention, tokenization and positional encodings, and how models are trained and served, with the ability to implement core components from scratch
PyTorch: expert-level, including custom model code, training loops, mixed precision and distributed training (e.g., FSDP, DeepSpeed)
Fine-tuning and post-training: hands-on full and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA) of open-weight LLMs, distillation, and preference or RL-based methods (e.g., DPO, GRPO)
Context engineering: retrieval, memory, and context management for long-running agent workflows
Inference optimization: deep knowledge of prefill and decode, KV-cache management (e.g., PagedAttention, prefix caching), continuous batching, speculative decoding, FlashAttention and quantization, and serving at scale with vLLM, SGLang or TensorRT-LLM
Evals: defining evaluation strategy and benchmarks for LLM and agent systems
Strong predictive AI and classical ML fundamentals, and the judgment to choose between them and LLMs based on accuracy, latency and cost
Strong distributed systems and Python fundamentals
Takes ownership of significant technical outcomes across multiple teams, proactively identifying and addressing risks, driving complex challenges to resolution and ensuring solutions deliver against agreed technical and customer objectives
Strong communicator with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to engineering, product, and leadership audiences
Builds strong cross functional partnerships across Engineering, Product, and other teams to align on technical direction and deliver shared outcomes
Connects customer needs and business priorities to technical decisions, evaluating the value, cost and trade-offs of AI solutions to ensure investments deliver measurable customer and business outcomes
Embody our core values to foster a culture of excellence that drives meaningful impact and collective success

Preferred Skills And Experience

Experience pre-training or training LLMs from scratch
Experience writing GPU kernels (CUDA or Triton) and profiling GPU workloads
Security domain experience, such as detection engineering, SOC/MDR, or vulnerability management
Experience running AI workloads on AWS at scale
Publications, patents, or open-source contributions in AI

We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams. That’s because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don’t be shy - apply today.

We do this by harnessing our collective expertise and passion to challenge what’s possible and drive extraordinary impact. We’re building a dynamic and collaborative workplace where new ideas are welcome.

Protecting 11,500+ customers against bad actors and threats means we’re continuing to push the envelope just like we’ ve been doing for the past 20 years. If you ’re ready to solve some of the toughest challenges in cybersecurity, we’re ready to help you take command of your career. Join us.

added.title: Lead AI Engineer, Platform
added.description:
ECP is a market-leading SaaS solution that enables senior living communities to better care for their residents. ECP is used in over 8,000 communities. We're looking to further expand by increasing the number of customers that use our software and increasing the scope of how we serve our customers by developing and releasing new products. 
Senior living is deeply under-penetrated with software and ECP is one of the largest and fastest-growing software companies in the industry. We recently raised a growth round of equity to reinvest in our product, technology, and go-to-market. Our mission is to build world-class software that improves the quality of life for seniors and improves clinical, business, compliance, and operational performance for our customers. 
The Role 
ECP Intelligence is the AI in our products. Customers want more of it, so we're forming a team that will work on it exclusively. The team is two people, you and a senior AI engineer, both reporting to the VP of Engineering for Platform. 
You lead the technical work and decide how features are designed, evaluated and released. You and your teammate share the feature work, and you own the team's plan. Most of your time goes to writing and reviewing code. 
The features appear inside our clinical, billing and CRM products, so you'll work with the teams that own those screens. You'll also work closely with the product manager, who agrees what counts as good enough for release. Caregivers act on what these features tell them, so before a feature ships we need to be confident on the quality of the output, and we need to keep measuring that after it's live. 
The stack. We write code primarily in Node and TypeScript, with some Python for data-related work. Operational data is in SQL Server and PostgreSQL, and we have a data warehouse on Databricks. ECP is a HIPAA product, so resident data stays inside our AWS account, and models run on Amazon Bedrock or we host them ourselves. 
What You'll Build 
Features on language models. These include summaries of a resident's recent history and of a shift, speech to text for charting, and document intake that reads a scanned or faxed document and files it to the right resident once a person confirms it. For each feature you'll choose the model, design the retrieval and prompts, and manage cost and response time. 
Predictive models. These flag residents at rising risk of a fall or a change of condition. This is classical machine learning on tabular and time-series data, and we train these models ourselves. 
Agents and an MCP server. This team will add an MCP server that lets a customer reach their ECP data from their own AI tools, and agents that take actions in the product. An agent has to act as a specific user, inside that user's permissions. 
Evaluation and release. Every feature gets an evaluation plan before it leaves prototype, test sets drawn from real usage, a gate that every model or prompt change has to pass, and quality monitoring once it's live. We have a draft of this process. You'll own it and write the tooling for it. 
Production. The team runs its own features in production. That includes alerts and the ability to turn a feature off or roll it back. We don't build language, OCR or speech models from scratch. We start from ones we can run inside our AWS account, and you'll choose which for each feature and decide when one needs tuning. You'll also decide which models and tools are allowed to handle resident data, based on where the data is sent and what the vendor's contract permits. 
What We're Looking For 
Required 
You've shipped features on language models to paying customers and run them in production afterward. You know what they cost to run and how they failed. 

You've written the evaluation for an AI feature and checked its scoring against human judgment. You used it to decide on releases, and it stopped at least one change from shipping. 

You've trained a predictive model on tabular or time-series data, shipped it, and measured it against real outcomes after launch. 

You've put sensitive or regulated data through a model, and you can say where the data went and which terms covered it. 

You've led a team's technical work without managing the team. You set the direction, reviewed designs and code, and mentored the other engineers. 

You're a strong software engineer apart from the AI. You've designed services and data models, tested them, and been on call for them. Most of our code is Node and TypeScript, and you've worked in them or in a similar stack. 

AI-augmented development is how you work. You run several agents on a task or several tasks in parallel, with one agent's output reviewed by another before you review it yourself. You've set up the shared instructions and review rules a team uses for this. 

You're a strong communicator. You've written the design documents a team worked from, and you've explained what an AI feature can and can't do to product managers, executives and customers. 

Preferred 
Healthcare, or time spent watching clinical or frontline staff work 

Agents that acted for a user, where you decided what they could reach and enforced it in code 

An MCP server, or another tool surface that agents outside your company used 

Document extraction with OCR, or speech recognition, in production 

Amazon Bedrock, or open models you hosted yourself 

NodeJS, Python, SQL Server, Databricks 

What Success Looks Like 
At six months, several ECP Intelligence features are generally available, and customers are paying for them. Each one has an evaluation plan, a release gate, and quality monitoring in production. 
After that the work moves toward agents. We'll judge it by how much time our customers' staff get back.

Description

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Just Walk Out (JWO) is a new kind of store with no lines and no checkout-you just grab and go! Customers simply use the Amazon Go app to enter the store, take what they want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and go!

Our checkout-free shopping experience is made possible by our Just Walk Out Technology, which automatically detects when products are taken from or returned to the shelves and keeps track of them in a virtual cart. When you're done shopping, you can just leave the store. Shortly after, we'll charge your account and send you a receipt. Check it out at amazon.com/go. Designed and custom-built by Amazonians, our Just Walk Out Technology uses a variety of technologies including computer vision, sensor fusion, and advanced machine learning. Innovation is part of our DNA! Our goal is to be Earth's most customer centric company, and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join an ambitious program that continues to push the state of the art in computer vision, machine learning, distributed systems, and hardware design.

Key job responsibilities

Everyone on the team needs to be entrepreneurial, wear many hats, and work in a highly collaborative environment that's more startup than big company. We'll need to tackle problems that span a variety of domains: computer vision, image recognition, machine learning, real-time and distributed systems.
As a Sr. Applied Scientist you will help solve a variety of technical challenges and mentor other scientists. You will be the thought leader of the team. Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About The Team

The Workforce Machine Learning (WFML) team is helping transform how HCM and Workforce is processed for Workday customers around the world. Compensation touches nearly everyone who works, and the data behind it is complex, time-sensitive, and deeply important. Our work helps customers process Compensation more accurately, efficiently, and confidently, so employees can be provided with right compensation package during their tenure correctly. We work with large-scale HR and Compensation datasets to build data and AI-driven solutions that improve the Compensation experience for administrators. In the year ahead, the team will focus on applying modern machine learning, generative AI, and AI agent technologies to deliver predictive analytics, recommendations, and automation that make Compensation benchmarking simpler and more effective.This is a team for people who enjoy solving meaningful problems with data. We value curiosity, thoughtful collaboration, and practical innovation. You will work with people who care about building trustworthy AI solutions that create real value for Workday customers and support Workday’s mission to make work better.

About The Role

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will help design, develop, and deliver AI and machine learning solutions that support HCM & Compensation products at global scale. You will work with product managers, software engineers, data scientists, and other partners to understand customer needs and turn rich HR and Compensation data into useful product experiences.

You will use Workday’s AI development environment and tools to explore data, build models, evaluate performance, and help bring machine learning capabilities into production. Your work will support predictive analytics, intelligent recommendations, and automated experiences that help Compensation administrators work more efficiently.

In this role, you will:

Develop data and AI-driven solutions for enterprise HR and Compensation products serving organizations of many sizes and industries.
Explore, prepare, and transform large-scale HR and Compensation datasets for machine learning use cases.
Design, build, evaluate, and improve machine learning models, prompts, and frameworks.
Partner with product managers, software engineers, and data scientists to bring applied machine learning capabilities from concept through production.
Apply modern machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, generative AI, and AI agent approaches to Compensation challenges.
Contribute to model development practices that support scalability, reliability, quality, and responsible use of AI.
Learn Compensation domain concepts and use that context to build solutions that are practical, trusted, and valuable for customers.

About You

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of experience as part of a data science, machine learning, or software development team.
3+ years of experience using Python and machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar tools.
3+ years of experience working with large-scale datasets, including data modeling, feature development, or data transformation.
3+ years of experience building, evaluating, or productizing machine learning models or algorithms.

Other Qualifications

Experience with machine learning, including selecting appropriate approaches, preparing data, training models, evaluating results, and applying models to practical product problems.
Experience with model building, including feature engineering, experimentation, performance analysis, and iteration based on data and user needs.
Experience with model development practices, including model evaluation, deployment considerations, monitoring, and improvement over time.
Familiarity with model-based design concepts, including using models to represent complex systems, test assumptions, and guide solution design.
Experience with deep learning, natural language processing, generative AI, distributed training, model hosting, or multi-agent AI systems.
Experience bringing applied machine learning products from design through production.
Ability to work collaboratively with product managers, software engineers, and data scientists to deliver customer-focused AI solutions.
Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and model behavior to technical and non-technical partners.
Interest in learning HR and Compensation data, processes, and customer needs.
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field is a plus

Overview

Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast-to-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP (Baker Tilly) provide professional services through an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable laws, regulations and professional standards. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms.

Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.

Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring.

Baker Tilly is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.

Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.

Job Description

What we're building

We're building AI agents that do real work for Baker Tilly's tax, assurance, and advisory teams. They read client files, find risks and opportunities, draft financial statement disclosures, and show their sources, and a practitioner always makes the final call. The data is some of the most sensitive in the business, so we build security in from the start.

Baker Tilly is the sixth-largest accounting and advisory firm in the U.S., with more than 11,000 people, and the firm is investing seriously in AI. We're a small team at the start of that work, and the engineers who join now will help decide what we build and how.

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll own an agent or product area from discovery to production. You'll work with practitioners to turn how experts do their jobs into software they trust, and help other engineers move faster.

What you'll work with

Years of client engagement history, tax returns, and financial records, at the scale of a major firm.
Tax, audit, and advisory practitioners who help define what good looks like and review what the agents produce.
Real users inside the firm who give direct feedback on what you build.
We work in partnership with frontier labs.
A mix of building and buying. You'll help decide which is which, and everything we ship meets the same standards for security, tracing, and testing.
Our stack: Python, TypeScript and React, Databricks, graph and vector databases, MCP, OpenTelemetry, and Braintrust, on Azure.

What you'll do

Own an agent or product area from the first conversation with practitioners through production and beyond, turning expert judgment into clear requirements and a way to measure success.
Build across the stack: frontend, backend, APIs, data, and the agent layer (retrieval, tools through MCP, orchestration).
Build the testing loop: tracing, expert-labeled ground truth, and release gates scored against what our experts say is right.
Build access control and human approval into the design from the start.
Decide what to build and what to buy, and bring in outside tools and agents to our standards.
Use AI coding tools extensively, and help us ship through a code factory more and more: agents do more of the building while engineers direct the work, review it, and own quality.
Run your own projects: break down vague problems, manage dependencies, and own what happens in production.
Review code, pair with people, and help other engineers get better.

Who you are

You're a hands-on technologist who has built things people actually use, ideally end to end, from the first conversation with users through production and after.
You're naturally curious, a strong problem solver, and a clear communicator.
You can take an objective, form an opinion, and move things forward on your own, even when the path is unclear.

What you bring

8 years of experience shipping and running production software, with ownership across frontend and backend preferred. We look at the scope you've owned.
You use AI coding tools extensively, and you have opinions about what works.
React and TypeScript, plus a backend language like Python, Node, Go, or Java.
You've built LLM features in production (retrieval, tool use, structured output, evals), or you pick up new technology fast.
You've led a project through to a reliable production release.
Good judgment on APIs, data design, cloud services, authentication, testing, deployment, and observability.
You see "is this allowed?" as a design input that shapes the solution.
You've worked directly with customers or domain experts, and you can explain a tradeoff clearly.
You make the people around you better through code review and coaching.
Bachelor's Degree Required

Nice to have

React, TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, Azure, Databricks, containers, or event-driven systems.
Graph or vector databases, MCP, or LLM evaluation and tracing.
Enterprise integrations, data with strict access rules, or regulated and professional-services settings.

In a year

A messy problem has become an agent practitioners trust, and you can measure it.
Your systems run reliably and are easy to change.
Other engineers work faster because of your reviews and practices.

Travel: Up to 30%

Position Summary

The Senior AI Application Developer is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and sustaining AI-enabled applications and workflows that improve decision-making and operational performance across two manufacturing divisions. This role is first and foremost an application development position, with a strong emphasis on applied AI, data, and full-stack development. The developer will build production-quality solutions using the PCC data and AI ecosystem, including Databricks, Python-based application frameworks, APIs, AI models, agents, and modern web technologies. Unlike a traditional centralized software development role, this position is expected to develop a strong understanding of the manufacturing environments it supports. The developer will spend time at manufacturing sites working directly with Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, Continuous Improvement, and other functional teams to understand processes, identify opportunities, validate solutions, and ensure applications work in the real operating environment. Travel of up to 30% is expected, particularly to build familiarity with manufacturing sites, processes, data, users, and business challenges across both divisions. The successful candidate will combine strong software engineering capabilities with curiosity about manufacturing and a practical, continuous-improvement mindset.

Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain AI-enabled applications and workflows supporting manufacturing and business operations.
Build full-stack applications using Python, JavaScript, and frameworks such as Dash, Streamlit, React, Flask, or similar technologies.
Develop applications using Databricks Apps and the broader enterprise data platform.
Build AI agents and AI-assisted workflows that automate analysis, improve access to information, and support operational decision-making.

Validate application outputs against actual operating conditions rather than relying exclusively on system data or stated requirements.
Participate in pilots, user testing, deployment, training, and adoption of new applications.

Work with business stakeholders to define measurable success criteria before development begins.
Balance rapid prototyping with appropriate production engineering practices based on the scale and criticality of the application.
Develop intuitive tools that fit naturally into existing business and manufacturing workflows.
Gather user feedback and translate it into prioritized application enhancements.
Maintain appropriate application documentation, data definitions, testing, controls, and support processes.

Data and AI

Integrate enterprise large language model and machine-learning capabilities into applications where they provide measurable value.

added.description:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What’s the opportunity?

The Research, Analytics & Data Science (RAD) team at Intercom uses data and insights to drive evidence-based decision-making. We're a team of data scientists and product researchers who use data - both big and small - to unlock actionable insights about our customers, our products and our business. We generate insights that build customer empathy, drive product strategy and shape products that deliver real value to our customers.

We’re now seeing strong demand for data scientists who can apply their expertise directly with our most strategic customers. As a Forward Deployed Data Scientist, you’ll embed with customers to build Enterprise-grade Fin deployments. You’ll play a pivotal role in transforming how our most strategic customers scale customer support — working closely with them and our go-to-market teams to design, build, and implement data-driven solutions that unlock measurable impact. You’ll also feed insights from these frontline deployments back into Intercom’s product and strategy — helping shape the future of AI customer service.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives in ambiguous environments, is energized by solving complex, real-world problems with data, and is motivated by seeing their work translate into both customer impact and product evolution.

What will I be doing?

Drive the adoption of Fin by helping customers automate and scale their support operations.
Embed with strategic customers to understand their support workflows, data, and business challenges — to identify and implement opportunities where AI can deliver measurable impact.
Steer customers toward best practices in measurement and AI adoption to realize the full value of Fin.
Partner closely with Sales, Success, and Product to deliver seamless customer experiences and successful deployments, and to create feedback loops that shape product development.
Use AI to prototype, test, and scale data-driven solutions, building tools that make us faster and more effective in driving Fin adoption and customer impact.

What skills do I need?

Proven ability to apply data science in real-world business contexts to drive measurable outcomes.
Strong collaboration mindset; skilled at working across Sales, Success, Product, and Engineering.
High adaptability and ownership: able to shift between deep technical analysis and high-level strategic framing.
Excellent communication skills, both technical and non-technical.
Rapid prototyping with systems thinking: you know when a customer needs a fast, bespoke answer, and when to build something others will keep using.
Excellent SQL and production-aware Python, you write code other people can run, not just code that runs once and are experienced applying analytical and statistical methods to real business problems.
Experience with AI/ML evaluation, LLM-driven applications, or conversational AI.
Willing to travel and work on-site with customers to build deep relationships and uncover insights firsthand.

Bonus skills and attributes

Experience in technical consulting, customer-facing analytics, or SaaS product data science.
Experience reframing the problem, not just solving it, you've spotted when the question you were handed wasn't the right one, and changed what got worked on.
Experience applying AI to scale the data science workflow.
Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required.

The base salary range for candidates within the Chicago Area is $185,000- $205,000. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Policies

added.description:
Job Description

Senior Data Scientist, People Analytics

We are Lennar

Lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making an impact and creating an extraordinary experience for their Homeowners, Communities, and Associates by building quality homes and providing exceptional customer service, giving back to the communities in which we work and live in, and fostering a culture of opportunity and growth for our Associates throughout their career. Lennar has been recognized as a Fortune 500® company and consistently ranked among the top homebuilders in the United States.

A Career that Empowers You to Build Your Future

As a Senior Data Scientist on Lennar's People Analytics team, you'll build the models that anticipate what's ahead for our workforce: attrition and turnover risk, hiring and headcount needs, and the trends underneath them. You'll also build the AI agents that deliver that work directly to HR leaders, so forecasts reach the point of decision rather than sitting in a report. This is a newly created position and the first dedicated data science role on the People Analytics team. You'll have significant latitude in shaping how the work gets done, from the modeling approaches we adopt to the standards we hold for validation and how results are presented to senior leadership. You'll work closely with HR COEs and hands-on with Workday and other people systems, plus the metrics Visier surfaces on top of them. You'll report to the Head of People Analytics.

Your Responsibilities On The Team

Partner directly with HR leaders to understand what they need forecasted or automated and build models and agents they trust enough to act on.
Build and deploy predictive models in Python and SQL. Monitor model performance over time, retesting as new data arrives and refining when accuracy drifts, so predictions and recommendations stay reliable.
Build AI agents that can query People data, reason over it, and take action, along with the tool use, orchestration, and guardrails that let them work safely with sensitive workforce data.
Select the method that fits the question, apply experimentation and causal inference where the question is about cause, quantify uncertainty, and be prepared to explain the approach to senior leadership.
Use LLMs to surface patterns in unstructured People data such as survey comments and exit interview notes and incorporate what you find into your models.
Develop deep familiarity with Lennar's people data, extracting and structuring what your models require, identifying gaps that would sharpen the output, and partnering with Data Engineering on the pipelines behind it.
Explain statistical concepts, model results, and agent behavior to HR and business audiences without a quantitative background.
Handle sensitive workforce and compensation data with discretion.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Statistics, Economics, Math, Computer Science, or a related analytical field with equivalent experience.
5+ years of relevant experience (1+ with PhD, 3+ with MS) as a data scientist producing models and engineering solutions in a production environment.
Depth in predictive modeling, including regression, time series forecasting, and classification.
A strong statistical foundation, including experimentation and causal inference, and the judgment to select the right method for the question at hand.
Proven ability to work independently, including designing your own validation approach and articulating your methodology to technical and non-technical reviewers.
Hands-on experience building with LLMs, whether agents, tool use and function calling, retrieval, or prompt-driven workflows, and using tools such as Claude to accelerate your own development. We're interested in what you've built and how you evaluated it, more than years of experience in a field this new.
Experience with large, complex operational or HR datasets, including cleaning and structuring messy data and extracting it yourself through SQL or APIs.
Fluency in SQL and strong proficiency in Python.
Ability to explain model results and agent behavior in plain language to non-technical HR and business leaders.

Physical & Office/Site Presence Requirements:

This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the incumbent to have the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. The Research, Analytics & Data Science (RAD) team at Intercom uses data and insights to drive evidence-based decision-making. How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

At Delta, we connect people and cultures, power extraordinary experiences, and shape the future of travel. Here, you'll work on complex challenges on a global scale, using augmented intelligence to build emerging technologies, amplify human potential and continuously grow the skills that keep you at the forefront of what's next.

The Data Scientist, Safety Intelligence is responsible for advanced data science, analytics, trend identification and monitoring, AI/ML application, data storytelling, and project-based analytical support for the Flight Safety Department. Reporting to the Grade 8 Safety Intelligence and Analytics Manager, this role serves as a senior technical contributor who applies analytical methods, safety data, AI/ML techniques, and decision-support tools to strengthen Safety Management System (SMS) processes and improve how safety risks are identified, assessed, monitored, communicated, and acted upon. This position is intended to provide deep technical capability in analytics, data science, and AI/ML while supporting the department’s Safety Assurance work. The role translates complex safety data into clear, compelling, and actionable insights, supports cross-functional safety analysis, coordinates analytical work tied to key safety initiatives, and helps ensure Flight Safety has credible, timely, and well-structured analytical input into SMS decision-making. Success in this role requires the ability to clearly articulate analysis and findings to technical and non-technical audiences alike, using language and framing that connects the data to operational meaning, risk implications, and recommended action rather than relying only on statistical or data science terminology. The role must also be able to present findings credibly to senior leaders and Flight Ops stakeholders, balancing technical rigor with clarity, relevance, and practical business impact.

Develop, apply, test, and refine data science, statistical, artificial intelligence, and machine learning approaches to analyze large, complex safety and operational datasets, identify meaningful patterns, and surface emerging safety risks.
Translate technical findings into clear analytical narratives, dashboards, briefings, and recommendations for Flight Safety leadership and cross-functional partners, linking data insight to operational and risk decisions.
Support recurring safety monitoring, special studies, and leadership-driven analytical requests by applying advanced analytical, statistical, and AI/ML techniques to evolving business and safety questions.
Partner with data engineering and technical stakeholders to define data requirements, improve source reliability, support automation, and strengthen the technical foundation for scalable analytical and AI-enabled products.
Design, build, validate, and improve reproducible analytical workflows, models, and AI-enabled decision-support tools that improve the speed, quality, and scalability of Flight Safety intelligence.
Evaluate analytical methods, model performance, data quality, assumptions, and output validity to ensure technical rigor and fitness for operational safety use cases.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

3–5 years of experience in advanced analytics, data science, or a closely related analytical field
Experience applying statistical, analytical, and machine learning methods to solve business or operational problems
Working knowledge of Git or similar version-control tools for code management
Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to explain analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
Strong project management, organization, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple analytical efforts and stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to work effectively across diverse people, perspectives, and working styles
Must be performing satisfactorily in present position
Demonstrated commitment to safety and security of self and others
Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.
Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.

added.description:
Job Description

As an AI Engineer II here at Honeywell, you will contribute to the design, development, and deployment of advanced artificial intelligence solutions that drive innovation and improve operational efficiency.

You will report directly to our leadership team and you’ll work out of our Atlanta, GA location on a hybrid work schedule.

In this role, you will impact critical AI projects by developing scalable AI models and collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate AI technologies into existing systems, enhancing business outcomes and operational excellence.

At Honeywell, our people leaders play a critical role in developing and supporting our employees to help them

perform at their best and drive change across the company. Help to build a strong, diverse team by recruiting talent, identifying, and developing successors,

driving retention and engagement, and fostering an inclusive culture

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy ML models for anomaly detection and pattern recognition across billions of smart meter events
Build time-series and event-based models that detect meter faults and abnormal usage with high precision
Own the full ML lifecycle, from feature engineering and training to deployment and production monitoring
Build scalable batch and near-real-time pipelines, and apply MLOps practices such as CI/CD, drift detection, and retraining
Partner with cross-functional teams to turn business problems into measurable AI solutions
Stay current with AI advances, including generative AI and LLMs, and bring proven techniques into production

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as science, technology, engineering, or mathematics
2+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying AI/ML models
Strong programming skills in Python (plus Go or C++), with hands-on experience in PyTorch or TensorFlow, scikit-learn, NumPy, and pandas
Experience with anomaly detection, time-series modeling, or large-scale data
Strong understanding of LLM architecture and inference, including attention mechanisms and the prefill and decode phases that drive live performance
Hands-on experience with inference engines and optimization stacks such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or ONNX Runtime

WE VALUE

Advanced degrees such as a Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related fields.
Experience working in agile development environments and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
Familiarity with cloud services like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for AI model deployment.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail in AI model development and tuning.
Knowledge of data engineering and software development best practices.

Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. Person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status or have the ability to obtain an export authorization.

In addition to a competitive salary, leading-edge work, and developing solutions side-by-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Honeywell employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. This package includes employer subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short-Term and Long-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 Paid Holidays. Learn more (https://benefits.honeywell.com/)

The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. Posting Date: November 18, 2026.

Honeywell Industrial Automation enables process industry operations, creates world-class sensor technologies, automates supply chains, makes warehouses smarter, and improves worker safety. This combination builds on our core strengths in controls and automation technologies which in turn allows us to deliver better commercial outcomes for our customers. We enable customers to enhance the safety, sustainability, resiliency and productivity of their people, plants and assets.

added.title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Ads Ranking
added.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It's built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet's largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

We are seeking a Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer to lead the technical direction of Reddit's Core Ads Ranking and mid-funnel modeling systems. Operating as a hands-on technical leader, you will advance user representation, graph learning, and sequence modeling across ads verticals—building foundational architectures that power downstream teams including Retrieval, Shopping, Click Prediction, Video View-Through Prediction, Conversion Prediction, and App Ads Modeling.

In addition to driving core ranking breakthroughs, you will elevate how ML engineering is executed across the org—leveraging modern AI-assisted development workflows (such as Claude, Cursor, and comparable tools) to accelerate experimentation, deepen error analysis, and raise the bar for modeling rigor and velocity.

Why Join Us?
This role offers a high-leverage technical platform to shape and scale Reddit's foundational ads modeling and deep user-understanding roadmap. If you are passionate about solving complex ranking, calibration, and sequence modeling problems at scale—while utilizing cutting-edge AI workflows to multiply your team's modeling impact—we'd love to talk to you.

What You'll Do:

Set Foundational Modeling Vision:
Define and execute the technical roadmap for Core Ads Ranking, user representation, graph learning, and sequence modeling across mid-funnel objectives (clicks, video views, and conversions), balancing long-term foundational bets with measurable production gains.
Advance Core Ranking & Distillation:
Lead high-impact initiatives in foundational model architectures, knowledge distillation, model calibration, and feature/embedding development to maximize model quality, reliability, and serving efficiency.
Multiply Impact Across Verticals:
Partner closely with downstream vertical teams (Retrieval, Shopping, App Ads, Video, and Conversion modeling), data science, product, and ML infrastructure to align on shared signals, architectures, and business outcomes.
Accelerate the Modeling Loop with AI Tooling:
Utilize AI-assisted development systems (Claude, Cursor, etc.) to investigate model behavior, automate hypothesis testing and error analysis, and build reliable, reproducible loops for architecture comparison, hyperparameter optimization, and experiment readouts.
Design Rigorous Evaluation Harnesses:
Build robust evaluation frameworks that measure both ranking/calibration outcomes and workflow quality, ensuring correctness, reproducibility, and strict latency/cost adherence.
Provide Senior Staff Technical Leadership:
Mentor engineers across the ads organization, guide technical design reviews, and elevate engineering standards for modeling rigor and modern ML workflows.

What We're Looking For:

9+ years of experience
in machine learning engineering, applied ML, or a related field, with a track record of substantial production impact at scale.
Senior Staff-level technical leadership:
Proven ability to set technical direction, drive alignment across multiple teams, and solve ambiguous, high-stakes modeling problems without direct management authority.
Deep Ranking & Foundational ML Expertise:
Strong fundamentals in large-scale recommendation/ads ranking systems, sequence modeling, graph learning, user/content understanding, model calibration, and knowledge distillation.
End-to-End Modeling Fluency:
Hands-on expertise in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow), covering data/label analysis, architecture design, distributed training, and production deployment.
Modern AI-Assisted Engineering Mindset:
Practical experience leveraging AI coding or agentic development tools to accelerate hypothesis generation, automate deep error analysis, and produce measurably better ML outcomes.
Collaborative, Low-Ego Communicator:
Clear, concise communication skills with the ability to influence both deep technical specialists and cross-functional product partners.
(Preferred) Direct experience in Ads Ranking, mid-funnel optimization (CTR/CVR/VTR), or multi-task/foundational ads architectures.

Benefits:

Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs
401k with Employer Match
Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
Family Planning Support
Gender-Affirming Care
Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
Generous Paid Parental Leave

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/.

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.

$266,000—$372,400 USD

During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. added.description:
About The Role

Hopper powers travel for some of the world’s largest banks, airlines and travel companies, and our Research team builds travel-specialized models. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer you take that work into a partner’s environment and make it theirs: building the evaluation with their team, preparing their data, training and evaluating the model, and putting it into production where it delivers measurable results. You work in a small forward-deployed team as the person who leads model training on site, across servicing, loyalty, commerce and more, and you are the bridge between our partners and Research.

What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like

Work with a partner’s data and business teams to turn their real tasks into a frozen, held-out benchmark across their priority use cases
Define what success means for each task, covering task completion, policy adherence, cost and response time, and build the automated graders with human spot checks
Establish baselines so results can be compared fairly
Prepare training data inside the partner’s environment through extraction, redaction, deduplication, labelling and train/test splits, using only the data the agreed tasks need
Run post-training in partnership with Research, applying modern fine-tuning methods to partner use cases
Run training on the partner’s cloud and GPUs, or in an environment they approve, under their security and access rules
Design experiments that show partners clearly what drives the results
Take models from evaluation into production based on evidence, then monitor quality, latency and cost once they are live
Use production results to keep improving the model
Present results, method and trade-offs to partner data and technology leaders, and defend them
Work closely with Research, feeding back what you learn in the field
Turn each deployment into reusable tooling so the next partner goes faster
Uphold strict data handling, privacy and security standards in every partner environment, and support partner model-risk, security and compliance reviews with clear documentation of data, training and evaluation

An ideal candidate has

Run the full post-training loop end to end themselves, from data preparation through fine-tuning an open-weight model, evaluation and serving, rather than only calling a vendor’s fine-tuning service
Working experience with supervised fine-tuning and at least one of preference optimization or reinforcement learning, including parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA
Strong Python and command of the standard training stack, for example PyTorch, Hugging Face and vLLM, with comfort running jobs on rented or customer GPUs
Built benchmarks and graders from messy real-world data and used them to show that one model beats another on quality, cost and latency
A habit of thinking in held-out sets, baselines and ablations, and can explain a result’s limits as clearly as its headline
At least two deployments embedded with an enterprise customer, working inside their systems, data controls and security reviews
Confidence presenting to and pushing back on senior customer stakeholders, including data and technology leaders
Strong data engineering skills across SQL, pipelines, PII handling and redaction
An understanding of the privacy, security and model-risk requirements of regulated customers such as banks and airlines
Willingness to travel and spend multi-week stretches on site with partners, plus a base in the Eastern or Central time zone with daily overlap across the partner and Research teams you work with
Bonus: forward-deployed, applied research or applied AI experience at an AI-native company that trains its own models for a domain
Bonus: multilingual training and evaluation, or experience with travel, airline or banking systems and data such as PSS, GDS, NDC, ticketing, loyalty and contact-centre data
Bonus: experience with agent systems and tool use, or working alongside a research team to turn their methods into results at a customer

Perks And Benefits Of Working With Us

Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages
Unlimited PTO
Carrot Cash travel stipend
Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend
Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!
Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business
Open communication with management and company leadership
Small, dynamic teams = massive impact
100% employer paid Medical, Dental and Vision coverage for employees
Access to Disability & Life insurance
Health Reimbursement Account (HRA)
DCA/ FSA and access to 401k plan

About Hopper

At Hopper, we’re building the leading travel technology platform in the world, and we’re doing it by solving real problems for real travelers globally. Our Hopper consumer booking platforms and HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), our B2B business, work together to give travelers something the industry has never reliably offered: transparency, flexibility, and real savings on every trip. We combine massive amounts of data and AI with proprietary fintech products to make that happen, not just another booking engine, but a fundamentally better way to plan and experience travel for our customers and our partners. We are proof that better-for-the-customer and better-for-the-business can be one in the same

And we’re continuing to grow fast! The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times, with 70% of our users being Gen Z and Millennials, next-generation travelers. Today, our biggest opportunity is powering travel fintech, commerce, and loyalty for some of the biggest brands in the industry. Our first HTS partnership with Capital One helped launch a dedicated travel portal for a major financial brand’s cardholders, and we’ve since expanded across some of the biggest names in travel and banking, including Air Canada, Uber, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), and Nubank, powering everything from a single fintech integration to a full end-to-end travel loyalty portal.

That’s our trajectory: we started as a small, disruptive app within the travel space, and now we’re the engine under the hood powering how Travel Tech works.

What That Looks Like In Practice

Billions of dollars in travel and travel fintech move through Hopper and HTS every year.
Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Disruption Assistance for Any Reason, post exceptionally strong customer satisfaction because the terms are clear and resolutions are instant, no questions asked.
Nearly 30% of app customers add a fintech product to their booking, and those customers are 1.6x more likely to book with us again.
HTS now drives more than 90% of the business, proof of how fast B2B has scaled.
Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies) can plug the company’s fintech, commerce and AI solutions into their own channels, whether that’s a single integration or a full end-to-end travel portal.

Come take off with us!

Our AI & Business Intelligence team delivers conversational assistants, intelligent search, data-driven agents, predictive analytics, and workflow automation that transform how businesses operate.
As a Mid-Level AI Software Developer, you will own and deliver production-ready AI features end-to-end. You will work across LLM integrations, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and AI-driven workflows, building reliable backend services and applications that directly impact enterprise customers.
This role is ideal for an experienced software engineer who has shipped AI-powered features in production and is ready to take full ownership of feature delivery, including performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. We are looking for candidates who are practical, collaborative, and comfortable making sound engineering trade-offs in real production environments.

Responsibilities:

Design and deliver AI-powered product features end-to-end, from requirements and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and post-release optimization.
Build and maintain retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) workflows that ground LLM responses in enterprise data, including application-side retrieval design, response grounding, and retrieval tuning.
Implement application and backend services that integrate large language models and AI services into enterprise products through well-designed APIs and service boundaries.
Develop AI-assisted workflows and agent-style automations that interact safely with enterprise data, product capabilities, and external systems.
Create and maintain automated tests, evaluation practices, monitoring, and operational runbooks for AI-enabled features so reliability is designed in from the start.
Analyze production behavior, user feedback, and telemetry to improve answer quality, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency. Make and communicate trade-offs between model quality, latency, and cost.
Collaborate with product, UX, data, QA, and platform teams to define use cases, acceptance criteria, evaluation methods, and rollout plans.
Contribute to engineering standards through code reviews, technical design discussions, and shared best practices focused on testing, observability, security, and performance.

What Success Looks Like

Owns AI-powered features end-to-end in production, from implementation through post-release improvement.
Uses telemetry, user feedback, and evidence to improve answer quality, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency.
Makes sound trade-offs between quality, latency, and cost, and can clearly explain those decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Delivers reliable, well-tested features with appropriate monitoring, evaluation, and operational readiness.
Collaborates effectively across engineering, product, UX, data, QA, and platform partners to ship high-quality releases.

Qualifications & Experience

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent demonstrated professional experience.

Technical Skills

Proficiency in one or more backend languages and frameworks such as C#/.NET, Python, or TypeScript/Node.js.
Hands-on experience building and shipping AI-powered features in production, such as LLM integrations, retrieval-based search, conversational assistants, intelligent agents, or workflow automation.
Experience designing APIs and service integrations in distributed or service-oriented systems.
Working knowledge of relational databases, including schema design, query fundamentals, and indexing concepts.
Familiarity with cloud-hosted AI services such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Bot Service, Microsoft Agent Framework, or comparable platforms.
Understanding of evaluation, monitoring, and reliability considerations for AI systems in production.
Understanding of cost-quality trade-offs in LLM systems, including examples such as model selection, token efficiency, caching, or reducing unnecessary API calls.
Proficiency with Git, code review, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices.

Experience

3+ years of professional software development experience, including production experience designing, building, testing, deploying, and monitoring applications end-to-end.
Experience shipping at least one production-deployed AI-powered feature with measurable customer impact within the past 18–24 months. This can be part of the 3+ years of total experience.
Experience working with real production constraints such as operational reliability, data governance, and cost-performance trade-offs in AI-enabled systems.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum and collaborative cross-functional development environments.

The Advantive Way

How Advantive works, in brief: six values, five promises, and three AI habits, one way of working. The values are who we are; the promises are what we deliver. This is what we hire for, at every level, and it applies to this role in full.
Our Values
: who we are
The bar below which no behavior is acceptable, on the floor, in the backbone, and in this role.

Humility

Team-first; team success ahead of self-interest.
Integrity

Candid; admit mistakes; do the right thing even when it costs.
Grit

Fortitude and fierce resolve; long-term goals over short-term comfort.
Results Orientation

Measured by results, not effort; execution over busyness.
Winning Attitude

Optimistic and determined; persevere through adversity.
Drive to Excellence

Seek feedback; learn, grow, be the best version of ourselves.

The Five Promises:
what we deliver
The standard by which all work is measured. Not values, but promises: harder to walk back, easier to coach against.
1.) Start where the work is. Go to the floor before the office; build from reality, not theory.
2.) Make it run. Ship software that runs where the work happens, and own it in production.
3.) Own the hard part. The customer's job is hard enough; we don't hand off the mess.
4.) Show up as a team. Heroes burn out; teams compound. No vanishing reps.
5.) Move their number. Outcomes, not activity. The number the customer is judged on, not ours.

How we work with AI

Openly Learn : share what works, failures included.
Nurture Curiosity : ask the model why; don't accept first answers.
Earn Trust: the operator decides what's true; verify before you ship.

About The Role

Hopper powers travel for some of the world’s largest banks, airlines and travel companies, and our Research team builds travel-specialized models. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer you take that work into a partner’s environment and make it theirs: building the evaluation with their team, preparing their data, training and evaluating the model, and putting it into production where it delivers measurable results. You work in a small forward-deployed team as the person who leads model training on site, across servicing, loyalty, commerce and more, and you are the bridge between our partners and Research.

What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like

Work with a partner’s data and business teams to turn their real tasks into a frozen, held-out benchmark across their priority use cases
Define what success means for each task, covering task completion, policy adherence, cost and response time, and build the automated graders with human spot checks
Establish baselines so results can be compared fairly
Prepare training data inside the partner’s environment through extraction, redaction, deduplication, labelling and train/test splits, using only the data the agreed tasks need
Run post-training in partnership with Research, applying modern fine-tuning methods to partner use cases
Run training on the partner’s cloud and GPUs, or in an environment they approve, under their security and access rules
Design experiments that show partners clearly what drives the results
Take models from evaluation into production based on evidence, then monitor quality, latency and cost once they are live
Use production results to keep improving the model
Present results, method and trade-offs to partner data and technology leaders, and defend them
Work closely with Research, feeding back what you learn in the field
Turn each deployment into reusable tooling so the next partner goes faster
Uphold strict data handling, privacy and security standards in every partner environment, and support partner model-risk, security and compliance reviews with clear documentation of data, training and evaluation

An ideal candidate has

Run the full post-training loop end to end themselves, from data preparation through fine-tuning an open-weight model, evaluation and serving, rather than only calling a vendor’s fine-tuning service
Working experience with supervised fine-tuning and at least one of preference optimization or reinforcement learning, including parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA
Strong Python and command of the standard training stack, for example PyTorch, Hugging Face and vLLM, with comfort running jobs on rented or customer GPUs
Built benchmarks and graders from messy real-world data and used them to show that one model beats another on quality, cost and latency
A habit of thinking in held-out sets, baselines and ablations, and can explain a result’s limits as clearly as its headline
At least two deployments embedded with an enterprise customer, working inside their systems, data controls and security reviews
Confidence presenting to and pushing back on senior customer stakeholders, including data and technology leaders
Strong data engineering skills across SQL, pipelines, PII handling and redaction
An understanding of the privacy, security and model-risk requirements of regulated customers such as banks and airlines
Willingness to travel and spend multi-week stretches on site with partners, plus a base in the Eastern or Central time zone with daily overlap across the partner and Research teams you work with
Bonus: forward-deployed, applied research or applied AI experience at an AI-native company that trains its own models for a domain
Bonus: multilingual training and evaluation, or experience with travel, airline or banking systems and data such as PSS, GDS, NDC, ticketing, loyalty and contact-centre data
Bonus: experience with agent systems and tool use, or working alongside a research team to turn their methods into results at a customer

Perks And Benefits Of Working With Us

Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages
Unlimited PTO
Carrot Cash travel stipend
Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend
Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!
Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business
Open communication with management and company leadership
Small, dynamic teams = massive impact
100% employer paid Medical, Dental and Vision coverage for employees
Access to Disability & Life insurance
Health Reimbursement Account (HRA)
DCA/ FSA and access to 401k plan

About Hopper

At Hopper, we’re building the leading travel technology platform in the world, and we’re doing it by solving real problems for real travelers globally. Our Hopper consumer booking platforms and HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), our B2B business, work together to give travelers something the industry has never reliably offered: transparency, flexibility, and real savings on every trip. We combine massive amounts of data and AI with proprietary fintech products to make that happen, not just another booking engine, but a fundamentally better way to plan and experience travel for our customers and our partners. We are proof that better-for-the-customer and better-for-the-business can be one in the same

And we’re continuing to grow fast! The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times, with 70% of our users being Gen Z and Millennials, next-generation travelers. Today, our biggest opportunity is powering travel fintech, commerce, and loyalty for some of the biggest brands in the industry. Our first HTS partnership with Capital One helped launch a dedicated travel portal for a major financial brand’s cardholders, and we’ve since expanded across some of the biggest names in travel and banking, including Air Canada, Uber, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), and Nubank, powering everything from a single fintech integration to a full end-to-end travel loyalty portal.

That’s our trajectory: we started as a small, disruptive app within the travel space, and now we’re the engine under the hood powering how Travel Tech works.

What That Looks Like In Practice

Billions of dollars in travel and travel fintech move through Hopper and HTS every year.
Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Disruption Assistance for Any Reason, post exceptionally strong customer satisfaction because the terms are clear and resolutions are instant, no questions asked.
Nearly 30% of app customers add a fintech product to their booking, and those customers are 1.6x more likely to book with us again.
HTS now drives more than 90% of the business, proof of how fast B2B has scaled.
Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies) can plug the company’s fintech, commerce and AI solutions into their own channels, whether that’s a single integration or a full end-to-end travel portal.

Come take off with us!

added.description:

Data Engineering
