About Taskrabbit:
Taskrabbit is a marketplace platform that conveniently connects people with Taskers to handle everyday home to-do’s, such as furniture assembly, handyman work, moving help, and much more.
At Taskrabbit, we want to transform lives one task at a time. As a company we celebrate innovation, inclusion and hard work. Our culture is collaborative, pragmatic, and fast-paced. We’re looking for talented, entrepreneurially minded and data-driven people who also have a passion for helping people do what they love. Together with IKEA, we’re creating more opportunities for people to earn a consistent, meaningful income on their own terms by building lasting relationships with clients in communities around the world.
Taskrabbit is a hybrid company with employees distributed across the US and EU and a Built In — Best Places to Work (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025) continually ranked across multiple national and regional categories. Join us at Taskrabbit, where your work will be meaningful, your ideas valued, and your potential unleashed!
Prior to applying please note:

We are currently

unable
to provide visa sponsorship for this position (including H-1B, OPT, F1, CPT or other employment-based visas). Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future. 

This role is hybrid requiring 2 days in office at our San Francisco hub every Tuesday & Wednesday (located at 130 Sutter St, San Francisco, CA).

About the Role
We're seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our remotely distributed AI full stack team, someone who builds with quality and care, and grows their impact across our ecosystem. Our AI & Innovation team is a new incubator for AI projects at Taskrabbit, focused on opportunities that improve the client experience, like how clients discover, describe, and book the help they need. The team's model favors throughput: quickly scoping, building, and proving out ideas. Once a project shows validated, high-impact results, it's handed off to the team best positioned to own it long-term. As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll dive deep into our systems, delivering new features while advocating for engineering rigor and operational excellence. You'll work both independently and collaboratively, tackling complex challenges and leaving a lasting impact on our codebase and processes.
Key Responsibilities
Architect:

Define the multi-quarter technical roadmap for AI & Innovation team (backend, frontend web client etc) along with the engineering manager and architects - driving strategy, addressing tech debt, and evolving scalable system architecture, APIs, and data models.
Tech Lead:

Lead complex, cross-team technical initiatives.
Solver:

Translate ambiguous, high-stakes business goals into clear technical strategies, designs, and experiments.
Multiplier:

Serve as a Javascript subject-matter expert, champion high-quality testing and AI practices,  mentor engineers, and produce durable technical documentation.
Champion AI-Driven Development:

Lead the adoption of Spec-Driven Development (SDD) leveraging advanced AI tools, ensuring engineers consistently turn well-defined specs into robust, scalable Node.js implementations and comprehensive test suites.
Spec-Driven Development (SDD):

Champion SDD practices using AI tooling, ensuring the consistent translation of precise specs into resilient Node.js implementations and thorough test suites.

Requirements
5 years professional software engineering including a mix of frontend and backend experience, with demonstrated impact (leading complex domains, influencing multiple teams).
Shipped AI work: Built and shipped at least one AI-powered feature or project end to end, at work or on your own. Examples include an LLM chat assistant, an MCP server or client, an agentic workflow, or a RAG-based search or Q&A experience.
LLM building blocks: Hands-on experience with prompt design, tool/function calling, structured outputs, embeddings and retrieval, and streaming responses in a Node.js/TypeScript stack.
Production AI quality: Experience evaluating and operating AI features in production. This means eval suites or golden datasets, guardrails, handling hallucinations and failures, and monitoring latency, and output quality.
Extensive professional experience with Node.js and microservice architecture; familiarity with Ruby on Rails is a plus.
Strong SQL and data modeling for experience (Postgres, Snowflake).
Hands-on experience with async/event-driven systems (Kafka) and microservice architecture.
Proven track record designing and owning observability/alerting for critical systems.
Mastery in building, debugging, and scaling distributed systems. 
Excellent communication, ability to influence without authority, and a strong ownership mentality for systems handling money and trust.

Bonus Points
Experience with Spec Driven Development. 
Hands-on AI tools experience.
Built or integrated MCP servers/clients that connect LLMs to internal APIs or data.
Built conversational or agentic experiences, such as chatbots, intake or booking assistants, or multi-step agents, especially customer-facing ones.
Experience with rebuilding legacy software systems.
Familiarity with microservice and event-driven architectures at scale.

Compensation & Benefits: 
At Taskrabbit, our approach to compensation is designed to be competitive, transparent, and equitable. Total compensation consists of base pay + bonus + benefits + perks. The base pay range for this position is $135,000 - $185,000. This range is representative of base pay only, and does not include any other total cash compensation amounts, such as company bonus or benefits. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed above and will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, qualifications, geography, and level.
You’ll love working here because:
Taskrabbit is a Hybrid Company.

We value flexibility and choice but also stay committed to regular in-person connection.
The People.

You will be surrounded by some of the most talented, supportive, smart, and kind leaders and teams -- people you can be proud to work with!
The Diverse Culture.

We believe that we make better decisions when our workforce reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. Women make up half of our leadership team and our diversity representation is above that of the tech industry average.

Taskrabbit offers our employees with employer-paid health insurance and a 401k match with immediate vesting for our US based employees. Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer, Agentic Developer Platform, to accelerate the adoption of AI-first engineering and agentic workflows across our software development ecosystem.

The engineer will partner with engineering teams to identify existing workflows that can be transformed using Generative AI, Microsoft Copilot, agents, and intelligent automation. The focus is on leveraging the Microsoft ecosystem, existing enterprise platforms, APIs, data, and developer tooling to deliver practical, reusable, secure, and production-ready agentic solutions.

This is a hands-on engineering role. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with demonstrated experience of building, integrating, evaluating, and operating AI agents and orchestrated workflows in enterprise environments.

Engagement Objectives

Identify and prioritize high-value engineering and SDLC workflows for AI-first transformation using Microsoft Copilot and the Microsoft agentic platform where appropriate.
Deliver production-ready agentic solutions for selected high-value use cases.
Create reusable platform capabilities, integration patterns, tools, and skills rather than isolated proofs of concept.
Put appropriate evaluation, security, reliability, observability, and cost controls in place.
Document the architecture and transfer of knowledge so internal teams can sustain and extend the solutions.

Key Responsibilities

AI-First Workflow Transformation

Assess existing engineering and SDLC workflows to identify opportunities for AI, agents, and intelligent automation.
Redesign workflows using the appropriate combination of LLMs, agents, deterministic software, automation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Rapidly prototype, validate, and produce selected use cases based on measurable business and engineering value.
Prioritize approved Microsoft capabilities and existing enterprise platforms over unnecessary standalone solutions.
Partner with engineering and business stakeholders to translate workflow challenges into scalable technical solutions.

Agentic Platform Engineering

Design and build production-ready AI agents and multi-step agentic workflows.
Develop reusable agent tools, skills, services, prompts, and integration patterns.
Implement tool and function calling, structured outputs, routing, planning and execution, context management, state, memory, and workflow orchestration.
Use single-agent, supervisor/worker, planner/executor, routing, and multi-agent patterns where appropriate.
Implement retries, fallbacks, checkpoints, validation, approvals, and failure-recovery mechanisms.
Establish reusable architecture patterns that other engineering teams can adopt.

Enterprise & Developer Platform Integration

Integrate agents with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Azure services, GitHub, and other approved enterprise systems, developer tools, APIs, and data sources, as appropriate to each use case.
Build integrations using Microsoft Graph, Power Platform connectors, REST APIs, SDKs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), events, and other supported interfaces.
Apply enterprise authentication, authorization, secrets management, data protection, and least-privilege principles.
Enable agents to safely retrieve information, invoke tools, and perform approved actions across Microsoft and other approved enterprise platforms.

AI-First Software Engineering

Use GitHub Copilot and approved Microsoft Copilot experiences throughout the development lifecycle, supplemented by comparable approved AI-assisted engineering tools when appropriate.
Apply AI assistance to design, coding, refactoring, testing, debugging, documentation, and troubleshooting.
Identify opportunities for agentic automation across requirements, development, code quality, testing, CI/CD, documentation, operations, and engineering analytics.
Demonstrate practices that can be adopted by the broader development organization.

Microsoft Copilot & Agentic Platform

Design solutions that use Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Studio when low-code orchestration, enterprise knowledge, actions, and user-facing copilot experiences are the best fit.
Use Microsoft Foundry and Foundry Agent Service for code-first, model-flexible, governed, and observable agent workloads when appropriate.
Build or consume reusable tools through MCP, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform connectors, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and secured enterprise APIs.
Implement connected agent and multi-agent patterns across Copilot Studio, Foundry agents, and specialized enterprise agents when they improve modularity and maintainability.
Integrate Microsoft Entra ID, managed identity, role-based access, telemetry, evaluations, and guardrails into the production design.
Publish agent experiences to Microsoft 365 Copilot, Teams, or other approved channels based on user needs and enterprise governance.

Evaluation, Reliability & Observability

Establish automated evaluation frameworks and representative test datasets for AI and agent workflows.
Evaluate grounding, retrieval quality, tool-call correctness, structured-output accuracy, workflow completion, and regression behavior.
Implement tracing, logging, telemetry, monitoring, and troubleshooting across multi-step workflows.
Measure and optimize quality, reliability, latency, token usage, and cost.
Build automated unit, integration, workflow, and AI evaluation tests and incorporate them into CI/CD.

Required Qualifications

Strong professional software engineering experience building and supporting production applications and services.
Strong programming skills in Python and modern backend or API development.
Hands-on experience building applications using Generative AI and large language models.
Demonstrated experience developing AI agents and agentic workflows.
Experience with LLM tool or function calling, structured outputs, orchestration, context and state management, and multi-step execution.
Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), grounding, embeddings, and enterprise information retrieval.
Familiarity with MCP or comparable agent-to-tool integration approaches.
Experience with LangGraph or an equivalent agent and workflow orchestration framework.
Strong experience with REST APIs, JSON, Git, automated testing, and CI/CD.
Experience deploying and supporting cloud-based applications.
Understanding application security, authentication, authorization, secrets management, and least-privilege design.
Experience with production logging, tracing, observability, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Hands-on experience using GitHub Copilot or comparable AI coding tools in day-to-day engineering.

Hands-on experience with the Microsoft Agentic Ecosystem, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Foundry Agent Service, or Microsoft Agent Framework.
Experience building and publishing enterprise copilots, custom agents, connected agents, or AI-powered developer tools for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Teams, or other enterprise channels.
Experience with multi-agent architecture and orchestration.
Experience with Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, or similar agent development frameworks.
Experience with vector databases, semantic search, and enterprise RAG.
Experience integrating GitHub, Jira, Confluence, and enterprise data sources.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native architecture.
Knowledge of enterprise identity and access management, including Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, and role-based access control.
Experience implementing human-in-the-loop approval, escalation, and governance patterns.
Experience optimizing LLM applications for quality, latency, reliability, and cost.

Production ready agentic solutions for selected high-value use cases.
Reusable agent tools, skills, services, and enterprise integration patterns.
Reference architecture covering security, identity, data access, orchestration, and human approvals.

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer
specializing in agentic applications, you will be the preeminent technical authority for our GenAI platform, setting architecture and strategy that spans multiple engineering organizations and shapes the company's long-term technology roadmap. You will lead the enterprise-wide integration of LLMs across our internal and customer-facing application portfolio. Your focus will be on driving cognitive automation at scale, transforming how the organization approaches decision-making and workflow automation, and establishing the engineering standards that define resilient, scalable, and observable distributed systems company-wide. You will operate as a force multiplier — influencing technical direction well beyond your immediate team and acting as a key partner to senior leadership in shaping the future of the platform.

Responsibilities

Architect and Own Agentic Systems at Enterprise Scale: Architect and lead the development of highly sophisticated, mission-critical intelligent agent systems that utilize LLMs to automate workflows, optimize operations, and elevate user experiences — setting technical direction across the entire engineering organization and influencing strategy at the company level.
Define and Own Enterprise LLM Integration Strategy: Own and drive the multi-year technical vision for integrating LLMs across the company's software ecosystem, ensuring robust, scalable, and maintainable communication and data exchange. Serve as the ultimate technical authority and final escalation point for LLM architecture decisions across the organization.
Lead the Enterprise Cognitive Automation Roadmap: Partner directly with senior leadership, product executives, and engineering leaders to define and own the company-wide strategic direction for cognitive automation. Champion Scalable System Design at Organizational Scale: Take ultimate technical ownership of the entire development lifecycle for the organization's most strategically important machine learning-powered tools and applications. Establish technical frameworks and architectural patterns that are adopted company-wide and that outlast individual projects or teams.
Define and Uphold Engineering Standards Across the Company: Set the engineering culture at the organizational level. Establish and enforce industry-leading standards for building production-grade, distributed machine learning solutions, and ensure consistent adoption across all engineering teams, not just your own.
Drive Technical Consensus and Shape Company Direction: Continuously research and experiment with emerging trends in machine learning, AI agents, and distributed systems. Translate findings into actionable technical strategy with measurable, company-wide impact, and represent the organization's technical point of view in industry and cross-company forums where relevant.
Lead Cross-Functional and Executive Alignment: Work closely with machine learning engineers, product teams, and senior/executive leadership to gather requirements, define strategic scope, and deliver high-impact solutions. Own technical alignment across the entire organization and serve as the primary engineering representative at the executive level.
Grow and Elevate Engineering Talent Organization-Wide: Mentor and elevate engineers at all levels, from mid-level to principal/staff, fostering a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning across the company. Own hiring strategy and serve as the final technical bar-raiser for senior and staff-level hires.

Advanced Degree: Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.
Proven Experience: 15+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering, with deep expertise in designing and building large-scale distributed systems. Extensive, hands-on experience architecting and deploying complex agentic applications leveraging LLMs in production at enterprise scale. Demonstrated track record of company-wide, and ideally industry-recognized, technical impact.
Strong Technical Skills: Expertise in Golang is strongly preferred. Deep proficiency in Python or similar languages, along with expert-level knowledge of cloud and container frameworks such as AWS and Kubernetes. Production Experience: Demonstrated success owning the design, deployment, and operation of mission-critical backend software in high-stakes production environments at company-wide organizational scale.
Collaborative Spirit and Technical Leadership: Exceptional communication and influencing skills, with a proven ability to build consensus among executive stakeholders, define engineering culture at the organizational level, and align the entire company on complex, high-stakes technical decisions.
Passion for Innovation: A genuine and demonstrated passion for advancing the state of the art in machine learning and natural language processing, with a track record of translating cutting-edge research into durable business impact at scale.

The Forward Deployed Engineer embeds with Hopper's partners, some of the world's largest banks, airlines and travel companies, to bring our AI into their business end to end: getting the data, building and tuning the models, and taking them to production. You will lead data and modelling on site as part of a small forward-deployed team, acting as the bridge between partners and Research. What makes the role distinctive is that the data that matters lives inside partners' own systems, so you make it usable, securely, and turn each deployment into reusable tooling that makes the next partner faster.

What would your day-to-day look like

Work on site with partner teams to connect to their systems, including on-premise and legacy platforms, and build secure, reliable data feeds.
Map messy, inconsistent commercial data from many sources into one clean model.
Build and run pipelines for large historical and near-real-time datasets, with monitoring and data quality checks.
Meet partners' security, privacy and IT review requirements, taking only the data the product needs.
Design, train and evaluate production ML models for a high-volume commercial use case, choosing the right approach and being clear about the trade-offs.
Build the evaluation and measurement that show whether the models are good enough, and where they aren't.
Build low-latency, high-throughput services that serve the models in production.
Design how the system decides what to answer and how, and how it improves from real usage.
Own reliability, cost and performance once the system is live.
Partner directly with technology and business teams, from first conversations to go-live.
Collaborate with Research and Product, feeding back what you learn in the field.
Turn each deployment into reusable tooling so the next partner goes faster.

An ideal candidate has

5+ years building and shipping production ML systems end to end, covering data, modelling, serving and monitoring, which you will apply to a high-volume commercial use case from day one.
Strong data engineering experience, having built and kept running pipelines over large, messy datasets, which you will use to turn partner data into one clean model.
Experience integrating with systems you don't control, such as enterprise, on-premise or legacy platforms, and working through a customer's security and IT review, so you can get partner data flowing securely.
Experience building and running services that handle thousands of requests per second at sub-second response times, which you will use to serve models in production.
Travel industry experience (airlines, hotels, OTAs, metasearch or travel technology) working with availability, rates, schedules and inventory, and the systems behind them such as GDS, NDC and airline and hotel reservation systems, so you can read partner data quickly and spot what matters.
Sound judgment on modelling trade-offs and the ability to explain them to non-technical partners, which you will use to guide partner teams through decisions from first conversations to go-live.
At least two deployments embedded with an enterprise customer, working inside their systems, data controls and security reviews, so you are ready to lead data and modelling on site.
Willingness to travel and spend multi-week stretches on site with partner teams.
Bonus: experience in both airline and hotel data, or in another high-volume marketplace (e-commerce, ad tech, fintech) as well as travel, to bring patterns from other verticals to each deployment.
Bonus: forecasting, estimation or recommendation models in production, and experience working alongside a research team to turn their methods into results at a customer.
Bonus: forward-deployed, solutions or integration engineering experience at an enterprise software or data company, or an advanced degree in computer science, statistics or a related field.

Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages
Unlimited PTO
Carrot Cash travel stipend
Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend

Small, dynamic teams = massive impact
100% employer paid Medical, Dental and Vision coverage for employees
Access to Disability & Life insurance
Health Reimbursement Account (HRA)
DCA/ FSA and access to 401k plan

About Hopper

At Hopper, we’re building the leading travel technology platform in the world, and we’re doing it by solving real problems for real travelers globally. Our Hopper consumer booking platforms and HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), our B2B business, work together to give travelers something the industry has never reliably offered: transparency, flexibility, and real savings on every trip. We combine massive amounts of data and AI with proprietary fintech products to make that happen, not just another booking engine, but a fundamentally better way to plan and experience travel for our customers and our partners. We are proof that better-for-the-customer and better-for-the-business can be one in the same

And we’re continuing to grow fast! The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times, with 70% of our users being Gen Z and Millennials, next-generation travelers. Today, our biggest opportunity is powering travel fintech, commerce, and loyalty for some of the biggest brands in the industry. Our first HTS partnership with Capital One helped launch a dedicated travel portal for a major financial brand’s cardholders, and we’ve since expanded across some of the biggest names in travel and banking, including Air Canada, Uber, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), and Nubank, powering everything from a single fintech integration to a full end-to-end travel loyalty portal.

That’s our trajectory: we started as a small, disruptive app within the travel space, and now we’re the engine under the hood powering how Travel Tech works.

What That Looks Like In Practice

Billions of dollars in travel and travel fintech move through Hopper and HTS every year.
Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Disruption Assistance for Any Reason, post exceptionally strong customer satisfaction because the terms are clear and resolutions are instant, no questions asked.
Nearly 30% of app customers add a fintech product to their booking, and those customers are 1.6x more likely to book with us again.
HTS now drives more than 90% of the business, proof of how fast B2B has scaled.
Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies) can plug the company’s fintech, commerce and AI solutions into their own channels, whether that’s a single integration or a full end-to-end travel portal.

Come take off with us!

added.title: Staff Software Engineer, Data and ML
added.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About The Team

Relativity Space pioneered large-scale additive manufacturing with our Terran 1 rocket, the largest 3D-printed object to fly. Now a distinct business unit within Relativity, Horizon Manufacturing Technologies is advancing next-generation manufacturing for aerospace and beyond. The team operates at the frontier of manufacturing innovation, where creativity meets capability. This is an environment where cutting-edge R&D is put into production, industrializing advanced manufacturing capabilities to solve customer problems. You’ll work alongside welders, robotics engineers, data scientists, and systems engineers at the intersection of hardware and software, creating an end-to-end additive manufacturing platform that serves a wide variety of applications. From exploring new materials to unlocking faster print speeds, to designing complex, organic geometries that can’t be built any other way, it’s high-impact work that sets the foundation for the future of advanced manufacturing.

Horizon is seeking a Senior Software Engineer with deep expertise developing data software components to develop and own the crucial backend software infrastructure that integrates data throughout our Stargate autonomous additive manufacturing platform. This role is ideal for a software engineer who thrives in cross-functional environments, enjoys owning full projects from design to deployment, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-moving R&D setting. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the development of a distributed data platform for Horizon's core technology, including large-scale WAAM printers, mobile robotic weld repair systems, and fully autonomous additive manufacturing systems. You’ll make key tradeoff decisions, mentor junior engineers, build new systems and tooling, and recommend / drive high impact across existing systems. You'll work closely with robotics, data, ML, and infrastructure engineers to develop clean, reliable, and maintainable software that integrates tightly with hardware and real-world processes.

About The Role

Design, develop, and lead the creation of core data components of Horizon's data platform, including:
Data technology abstraction and API development.
Analytics and reporting architectures.
Data modeling, management, and development.
Cloud and on-prem application / services / API development.

About You

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
10+ years of experience implementing code level patterns to enable codebases and teams to scale, with 5+ years of experience leading data architectures at scale.
8+ years of experience leveraging an array of data technologies including one or many of the following: InfluxDB, MongoDB, Redis, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, Kafka, Spark, and more.
8+ years of experience with at least one of C++, Go, Python, C#, or Typescript.
Familiarity with agile methodologies.
Familiarity with containerization and deployment technologies like Kubernetes and Docker.

Nice To Haves But Not Required

Experience with AI technologies and agentic software development workflows
Familiarity with Robot Operating System (ROS)
Experience developing software for robotics or additive manufacturing applications
Prior experience in a small company or startup where you owned software end-to-end

At Relativity Space, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation practices. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

Compensation is only one part of our total rewards package. Relativity Space offers competitive salary and equity, a generous PTO and sick leave policy, parental leave, an annual learning and development stipend, and more! To see some of the benefits & perks we offer, please visit here.

Hiring Range

$172,000—$258,000 USD

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at accommodations@relativityspace.com.

Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission - via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee - will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.

added.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied ML and Data
added.description:
About The Role

The Forward Deployed Engineer embeds with Hopper's partners, some of the world's largest banks, airlines and travel companies, to bring our AI into their business end to end: getting the data, building and tuning the models, and taking them to production. You will lead data and modelling on site as part of a small forward-deployed team, acting as the bridge between partners and Research. What makes the role distinctive is that the data that matters lives inside partners' own systems, so you make it usable, securely, and turn each deployment into reusable tooling that makes the next partner faster.

What would your day-to-day look like

Work on site with partner teams to connect to their systems, including on-premise and legacy platforms, and build secure, reliable data feeds.
Map messy, inconsistent commercial data from many sources into one clean model.
Build and run pipelines for large historical and near-real-time datasets, with monitoring and data quality checks.
Meet partners' security, privacy and IT review requirements, taking only the data the product needs.
Design, train and evaluate production ML models for a high-volume commercial use case, choosing the right approach and being clear about the trade-offs.
Build the evaluation and measurement that show whether the models are good enough, and where they aren't.
Build low-latency, high-throughput services that serve the models in production.
Design how the system decides what to answer and how, and how it improves from real usage.
Own reliability, cost and performance once the system is live.
Partner directly with technology and business teams, from first conversations to go-live.
Collaborate with Research and Product, feeding back what you learn in the field.
Turn each deployment into reusable tooling so the next partner goes faster.

An ideal candidate has

5+ years building and shipping production ML systems end to end, covering data, modelling, serving and monitoring, which you will apply to a high-volume commercial use case from day one.
Strong data engineering experience, having built and kept running pipelines over large, messy datasets, which you will use to turn partner data into one clean model.
Experience integrating with systems you don't control, such as enterprise, on-premise or legacy platforms, and working through a customer's security and IT review, so you can get partner data flowing securely.
Experience building and running services that handle thousands of requests per second at sub-second response times, which you will use to serve models in production.
Travel industry experience (airlines, hotels, OTAs, metasearch or travel technology) working with availability, rates, schedules and inventory, and the systems behind them such as GDS, NDC and airline and hotel reservation systems, so you can read partner data quickly and spot what matters.
Sound judgment on modelling trade-offs and the ability to explain them to non-technical partners, which you will use to guide partner teams through decisions from first conversations to go-live.
At least two deployments embedded with an enterprise customer, working inside their systems, data controls and security reviews, so you are ready to lead data and modelling on site.
Willingness to travel and spend multi-week stretches on site with partner teams.
Bonus: experience in both airline and hotel data, or in another high-volume marketplace (e-commerce, ad tech, fintech) as well as travel, to bring patterns from other verticals to each deployment.
Bonus: forecasting, estimation or recommendation models in production, and experience working alongside a research team to turn their methods into results at a customer.
Bonus: forward-deployed, solutions or integration engineering experience at an enterprise software or data company, or an advanced degree in computer science, statistics or a related field.

Perks And Benefits Of Working With Us

Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages
Unlimited PTO
Carrot Cash travel stipend
Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend
Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!
Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business
Open communication with management and company leadership
Small, dynamic teams = massive impact
100% employer paid Medical, Dental and Vision coverage for employees
Access to Disability & Life insurance
Health Reimbursement Account (HRA)
DCA/ FSA and access to 401k plan

About Hopper

At Hopper, we’re building the leading travel technology platform in the world, and we’re doing it by solving real problems for real travelers globally. Our Hopper consumer booking platforms and HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), our B2B business, work together to give travelers something the industry has never reliably offered: transparency, flexibility, and real savings on every trip. We combine massive amounts of data and AI with proprietary fintech products to make that happen, not just another booking engine, but a fundamentally better way to plan and experience travel for our customers and our partners. We are proof that better-for-the-customer and better-for-the-business can be one in the same

And we’re continuing to grow fast! The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times, with 70% of our users being Gen Z and Millennials, next-generation travelers. Today, our biggest opportunity is powering travel fintech, commerce, and loyalty for some of the biggest brands in the industry. Our first HTS partnership with Capital One helped launch a dedicated travel portal for a major financial brand’s cardholders, and we’ve since expanded across some of the biggest names in travel and banking, including Air Canada, Uber, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), and Nubank, powering everything from a single fintech integration to a full end-to-end travel loyalty portal.

That’s our trajectory: we started as a small, disruptive app within the travel space, and now we’re the engine under the hood powering how Travel Tech works.

What That Looks Like In Practice

Billions of dollars in travel and travel fintech move through Hopper and HTS every year.
Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Disruption Assistance for Any Reason, post exceptionally strong customer satisfaction because the terms are clear and resolutions are instant, no questions asked.
Nearly 30% of app customers add a fintech product to their booking, and those customers are 1.6x more likely to book with us again.
HTS now drives more than 90% of the business, proof of how fast B2B has scaled.
Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies) can plug the company’s fintech, commerce and AI solutions into their own channels, whether that’s a single integration or a full end-to-end travel portal.

Come take off with us!

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

The Prime Video Title Lifecycle Presentation team sits at the intersection of science, experimentation, and customer experience. We leverage data signals and rigorous testing to present the most engaging information about our content to customers at precisely the right moment. Our mission is to ensure every customer interaction with Prime Video content is informed, relevant, and compelling in order to drive discovery and engagement across our vast catalog.

Every day, hundreds of millions of customers browse Prime Video. We already have a different team working on what to recommend, but this team is solving something harder: why should you watch it?

The team optimizes the signals that convince a customer to press play. Think "Trending Now," "100% on Rotten Tomatoes," or "Most Watched This Week", the contextual cues that turn browsing into watching. Last year, by rigorously testing how we present these signals, we drove 116 million incremental streaming hours. Now we're building what comes next.

We're creating an ML-powered platform that dynamically personalizes content signals for each customer, in each moment, across every surface (detail pages, homepages, carousels, and beyond). The core challenge: given a title, a customer, and a context, which signal (or combination of signals) maximizes the probability of engagement? This is not traditional ranking (we're not deciding which titles to show). We sit downstream of discovery, so once a title is surfaced, we determine the most compelling way to present it so the customer converts.

added.title: Principal Applied Scientist, Agentic Outbound Communications Marketplace
added.description:
Description

Outbound is re-imagining the communications and marketing landscape with advanced generative and agentic AI, changing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We're a passionate group of innovators building responsible, intelligent AI that balances the needs of brands and shoppers, improves the shopping experience, and strengthens the marketplace.

Amazon reaches shoppers billions of times through email, mobile push, SMS, and other messaging channels. Today, which message a shopper gets, on which channel, and when is decided mostly by marketers and category owners scheduling campaigns. We're replacing that with a marketplace. Agentic marketers and category owners are the demand. Each shopper's limited, per-channel attention (an email slot, a push notification, an SMS) is the supply. An auction decides which message earns each attention unit, and an autonomous research loop keeps improving the system against shopper engagement.

As a Principal Applied Scientist, You'll Set The Scientific Direction For This Marketplace And Own The Models And Methods It Runs On

Market and mechanism design. Define the value-based bid currency (predicted value to the shopper and the business, not cash) and the allocation mechanism across shoppers, channels, and send times. The mechanism needs to reward honest value reporting by agents, respect hard shopper-protection constraints, and keep any one category from crowding out the rest.
Shopper value, response, and fatigue modeling. Build the models that price an attention unit: open, click, and conversion prediction; unsubscribe and complaint risk; send-time and channel affinity; and the long-term cost each message imposes on a shopper's future attention.
Simulation science. Lead the science behind a high-scale synthetic environment of marketer agents and shoppers. Calibrate it against production, measure the sim-to-real gap, and use it to find bidding strategies that game the auction before real shoppers see them.
Autoresearch and autonomous optimization. Following Andrej Karpathy's autoresearch pattern, agents run closed experiment loops: propose a change to scoring, allocation, or send-time policy, test it in simulation and then on a small slice of live traffic, score it against a fixed objective, and keep or revert the change. You'll define the objective (CTR with guardrails), the evaluation methodology, and the statistical rules that let the loop run without fooling itself or eroding shopper trust.

Key job responsibilities

Set the multi-year science roadmap for the agentic communications marketplace and align science, engineering, product, and marketing leaders around it.
Design and analyze the allocation mechanism and bid currency, including incentive properties, budget and quota allocation across categories and programs, and behavior when every participant is an LLM agent.
Build and launch shopper response and fatigue models that work at Amazon scale and in real time across email, push, SMS, and in-app channels.
Define the marketplace objective. CTR is the primary signal, but the objective has to guard against the obvious failure mode, a system that sends more, clickbait-style messages, by accounting for unsubscribes, complaints, deliverability and sender reputation, downstream conversions, and long-term shopper engagement.
Lead causal and counterfactual evaluation (holdouts, long-term effect estimation) so offline and simulated results reliably predict online impact.
Develop the methodology for autonomous experimentation: experiment budgets, multiple-testing and sequential-testing controls, overfitting protection, and safe rollout and rollback criteria.
Apply reinforcement learning, contextual bandits, and constrained optimization to send-time, channel, and allocation decisions.
Publish internally and externally, file patents, and represent Amazon in the research community on agentic marketplaces and AI-driven communications.
Mentor scientists and engineers and raise the science bar across Outbound.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of hands-on work in predictive modeling and analysis experience
PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field
Experience working in predictive modeling and analysis
Experience distilling informal customer requirements into problem definitions, dealing with ambiguity and competing objectives
Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
Experience with leading experienced scientists as well as having a record of developing junior members from academia or industry to a career track in a business environment

Preferred Qualifications

10+ years of relevant work in industry or academia experience
Knowledge of problem solving, algorithm design and complexity analysis
Experience creating novel algorithms and advancing the state of the art
Have peer-reviewed scientific contributions in premier journals and conferences

The Sr. Lead Data Scientist is a senior individual contributor and technical leader within the data science organization, responsible for designing, developing, and delivering advanced machine learning and statistical solutions in a complex, high-volume, high-throughput data environment. This role plays a critical leadership function by owning end-to-end modeling initiatives, guiding analytical direction for major business problems, and mentoring data scientists across multiple projects.

This position is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence modeling standards and best practices, and partner closely with engineering, product, and business leaders to translate strategic objectives into scalable, production-ready analytics solutions.

Essential Functions

Advanced Modeling & Technical Leadership

Leads the design, experimentation, and implementation of advanced machine learning, statistical, and optimization models to solve complex, high-impact business problems.
Serves as the technical owner for large-scale, business-critical models, including model selection, feature engineering, training strategy, validation, and performance monitoring.
Drives development of complex consumer or entity profiles used for both offline model training and real-time scoring.
Assesses and ensures long-term performance, stability, scalability, and interpretability of analytically derived models in production environments.
Establishes modeling standards, evaluation frameworks, and best practices adopted across the data science team.

Project & Cross-Functional Leadership

Takes a lead role in the development and delivery of product-prototype and production models, coordinating across multiple data science and engineering contributors.
Partners with software engineers and MLOps teams to define statistical components, data requirements, unit testing, acceptance testing, and deployment strategies.
Translates ambiguous, high-level business goals into clearly defined analytical problems, roadmaps, and measurable success criteria.
Identifies and recommends new modeling, analytics, and data opportunities aligned with business strategy.

Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing

Acts as a senior mentor and subject matter expert, coaching junior and mid-level data scientists on modeling techniques, analytical thinking, and technical execution.
Reviews analytical work, model designs, and code for quality, rigor, and alignment with best practices.
Shares knowledge of emerging technologies, tools, and methodologies through documentation, presentations, and informal leadership.

Communication & Documentation

Clearly documents model design, assumptions, workflows, and performance results for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Presents analytical findings, model outcomes, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership with clarity and confidence.

Data Stewardship & Compliance

Supports the company’s commitment to protecting the integrity, confidentiality, and appropriate use of systems and data.
Ensures models and analytical solutions adhere to governance, regulatory, and ethical standards.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field.
Typically 10+ years of professional experience in predictive modeling, machine learning, statistical analysis, or equivalent advanced education and experience.
Extensive hands-on experience working with large, complex datasets in high-volume environments.
Advanced proficiency in data science and machine learning tools and technologies such as Python, R, SQL, Spark, Hadoop, Hive, Java, or equivalent.
Deep experience with a broad range of machine learning methods, including classification, regression, tree-based models, SVMs, ensemble methods, and optimization techniques.
Proven ability to translate business requirements into robust analytical designs and production-ready models.
Strong communication skills with demonstrated ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating data scientists on complex projects.
Successful completion of background and drug screening.

Preferred Qualifications

PhD or Master’s Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.
Deep expertise in advanced machine learning algorithms and modern ML frameworks and libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, pandas, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
Strong experience writing, optimizing, and tuning complex SQL queries.
Experience designing and maintaining data science pipelines and workflows in Python, R, or similar languages.
Experience working with financial or regulated data environments.
Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments while balancing multiple priorities.
Track record of discovering non-obvious insights and patterns in complex datasets.

Assesses and ensures long-term performance, stability, scalability, and interpretability of analytically derived models in production environments.
Establishes modeling standards, evaluation frameworks, and best practices adopted across the data science team.

Project & Cross-Functional Leadership

Takes a lead role in the development and delivery of product-prototype and production models, coordinating across multiple data science and engineering contributors.
Partners with software engineers and MLOps teams to define statistical components, data requirements, unit testing, acceptance testing, and deployment strategies.
Translates ambiguous, high-level business goals into clearly defined analytical problems, roadmaps, and measurable success criteria.
Identifies and recommends new modeling, analytics, and data opportunities aligned with business strategy.

Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing

Acts as a senior mentor and subject matter expert, coaching junior and mid-level data scientists on modeling techniques, analytical thinking, and technical execution.
Reviews analytical work, model designs, and code for quality, rigor, and alignment with best practices.
Shares knowledge of emerging technologies, tools, and methodologies through documentation, presentations, and informal leadership.

Communication & Documentation

Clearly documents model design, assumptions, workflows, and performance results for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Presents analytical findings, model outcomes, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership with clarity and confidence.

Data Stewardship & Compliance

Supports the company’s commitment to protecting the integrity, confidentiality, and appropriate use of systems and data.
Ensures models and analytical solutions adhere to governance, regulatory, and ethical standards.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field.
Typically 10+ years of professional experience in predictive modeling, machine learning, statistical analysis, or equivalent advanced education and experience.
Extensive hands-on experience working with large, complex datasets in high-volume environments.
Advanced proficiency in data science and machine learning tools and technologies such as Python, R, SQL, Spark, Hadoop, Hive, Java, or equivalent.
Deep experience with a broad range of machine learning methods, including classification, regression, tree-based models, SVMs, ensemble methods, and optimization techniques.
Proven ability to translate business requirements into robust analytical designs and production-ready models.
Strong communication skills with demonstrated ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating data scientists on complex projects.
Successful completion of background and drug screening.

Preferred Qualifications

PhD or Master’s Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.
Deep expertise in advanced machine learning algorithms and modern ML frameworks and libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, pandas, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
Strong experience writing, optimizing, and tuning complex SQL queries.
Experience designing and maintaining data science pipelines and workflows in Python, R, or similar languages.
Experience working with financial or regulated data environments.
Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments while balancing multiple priorities.
Track record of discovering non-obvious insights and patterns in complex datasets.

Physical Requirements

Working conditions consist of a normal office environment. Work is primarily sedentary and requires extensive use of a computer and involves sitting for periods of approximately four hours. Work may require occasional standing, walking, kneeling, and reaching. Must be able to lift 10 pounds occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently. Requires visual acuity and dexterity to view, prepare, and manipulate documents and office equipment including personal computers. Requires the ability to communicate with internal and/or external customers.

The Base Pay Scale For This Position In

Phoenix, AZ/ Chicago, IL in USD per year is: $150,000 - $200,000.

New York, NY/ San Francisco, CA in USD per year is: $210,000 - $270,000.

Additionally, candidates are eligible for a discretionary incentive plan and benefits.

This pay scale is subject to change and is not necessarily reflective of actual compensation that may be earned, nor a promise of any specific pay for any specific candidate, which is always dependent on legitimate factors considered at the time of job offer. The business actively supports and reviews wage equity to ensure that pay decisions are not based on gender, race, national origin, or any other protected classes.

Some of the Ways We Prioritize Your Health and Happiness

Job Description

Thomson Reuters Special Services (TRSS) is looking for a Data Scientist to support our Federal Law Enforcement customers. TRSS Data Scientists serve several Federal Law Enforcement agencies by collecting, integrating, resolving, analyzing, modeling, and explaining large data in support of complex investigations. Success in this role requires strong technical depth, the initiative to operate with minimal direction, creativity to develop novel solutions, the ability to work directly with customers, and a mission-focused mindset.

TRSS Data Scientists support the full range of Federal Law Enforcement missions including, but not limited to: Emerging Threat Detection, Money Laundering, Fraud, Force Protection, Human Rights Crimes, Transnational Crime, and more. Outside of contract work, TRSS Data Scientists contribute to internal innovation by participating in research and development (R&D), developing and maintaining shared capabilities, strengthening technical skills, and supporting business development efforts such as proof-of-concept projects and capabilities briefings.

This opportunity is specifically for positions located on US Government customer sites in the Arlington
, Merrifield, Fairfax, Crystal City, and DC
area. This is not a telework position.
We recruit from a broad range of disciplines and experience. If you are passionate about the chance to put your Data Science skills to practice in support of Federal Law Enforcement, then we are looking for you!

Key Responsibilities

Data Scientists in this role will support Federal Law Enforcement missions by applying technical expertise to complex investigative and operational challenges. Responsibilities include:

Collect, integrate, clean, verify, resolve, and maintain large and complex datasets.
Analyze data using statistical methods, graph networks, anomaly detection, spatial analysis, pattern-of-life analysis, sentiment analysis, and related techniques.
Develop and apply data models, including risk models, community detection, classification, computer vision, machine learning, and artificial intelligence models.
Translate data findings into actionable insights through dashboards, visualizations, briefings, and clear explanations for technical and non-technical audiences.
Write, edit, customize, and execute Python code to support mission requirements.
Use SQL for data extraction, pipelining, exploration, and analysis.
Work directly with customers to understand problem statements, define project goals, develop methods, and deliver results within required timeframes.
Contribute to internal innovation, research and development, shared capabilities, technical skill development, and business development efforts such as proof-of-concept projects and capabilities briefings.

Required Qualifications

United States Citizenship, as required to comply with government contract requirements.
Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance or agency work suitability determination, as required by assignment.
Willingness to work full time on-site at U.S. Government customer sites in the Arlington, Merrifield, Fairfax, Crystal City, and DC area. This is not a telework position.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field, such as data science, statistics, computer science, mathematics, physical or biological sciences, geographic information systems, or a related discipline.
At least 3 years of relevant experience in data management, data analysis, data modeling, data storytelling, programming, SQL, or related technical areas.
Practical experience writing, editing, customizing, and executing code in Python.
Experience using SQL for data extraction, pipelining, exploration, or analysis.
Ability to handle sensitive, confidential, or regulated data in accordance with applicable policies and requirements.
Ability to interface directly with customers at all levels and represent TRSS professionally.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively with Data Scientists, Subject Matter Expert Analysts, Data Engineers, and cross-disciplinary teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Preference will be given to candidates who meet the required qualifications and also bring one or more of the following:

Current/Active government work suitability or security clearance.
Experience working with law enforcement agencies.
Programming skills in multiple languages other than Python (Python is a minimum requirement) including R, Java, or SQL.
Experience with software development, including managing collaborative codebases, version control, linting/testing, containerization, and interacting with REST APIs

What’s in it For You?

Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption & Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The base compensation range varies across locations. Eligible office location(s) for this role include one or more of the following: New York City, San Francisco, Los Angeles, and/or Irvine, CA; McLean, VA; Washington, DC. The base compensation range for the role in any of those locations is $117,700 USD - $218,600 USD. For any eligible US locations, unless otherwise noted, the base compensation range for this role is $102,200 USD - $189,800 USD. Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs. This role may also be eligible for an Annual Bonus based on a combination of enterprise and individual performance.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

Thomson Reuters makes reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities, including veterans with disabilities, and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. If you reside in the United States and require an accommodation in the recruiting process, you may contact our Human Resources Department at HR.Leave-Expert@thomsonreuters.com. Disability accommodations in the recruiting process may include things like a sign language interpreter, making interview rooms accessible, providing assistive technology, or other relevant accommodations. Please note this email is not intended for general recruitment questions and we will promptly respond to inquiries regarding accommodations. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Personal Information We Collect

Your Privacy Choices

Team Overview

The Financial Services Analytics team partners with banks, lenders, insurers, and other financial institutions to solve complex business challenges using advanced analytics and TransUnion data assets. The team delivers predictive modeling, risk analytics, fraud solutions, and business intelligence insights that help clients make smarter business decisions and drive measurable outcomes. This role reports to Director of Data Science and Analytics. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

You will partner with internal and external cross-functional teams to drive new business initiatives and deliver long term value-added solutions to various TransUnion customers. These tasks will include –among others- the development of predictive models and business intelligence solutions of moderate scope and complexity for customers within the various industries served by TransUnion.
You will lead analytic client engagements involving descriptive, predictive, and prescriptive analysis for a variety of business use cases leveraging multiple analytic techniques. As a project leader, you will take ownership of all aspects of the project from design, to development, to peer review, to client presentation, to implementation and audit.
You will identify strategies and opportunities for customers to test and adopt TransUnion’s analytic products and services and develop project proposals, sales presentations and promotional collateral to enable the adoption of integrated customer solutions supported by TransUnion, applying your practical analytic experience to find areas of new value of TransUnion customers. In the context of these opportunities, you will interact directly with TransUnion Sales and business unit partners and provide an analytic perspective and general support as needed.
You will design, write, and test programs for data extraction, segmentation and statistical analysis on large population datasets using languages such as R, Python, SQL, Hive and Spark, formalizing some of these efforts into repeatable process improvements.
You will deliver analytic insights and recommendations in succinct and compelling presentations for internal and external customers representing a wide range of backgrounds and levels. You will foster a high performance culture and cultivate an environment that promotes excellence and reflects the TransUnion brand.

Required Knowledge And Experiences

Master’s or PhD degree in statistics, applied mathematics, financial mathematics, computer science, engineering, operations research, or other highly quantitative field; or a Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field with at least three (3) years of relevant professional experience. In either case, the candidate will demonstrate a consistent track record of academic excellence.
Experience and demonstrated success in client-facing roles over a period of at least one (1) year as well as at least one (1) year of professional experience performing analytic work, preferably in the Financial Services industry.
Demonstrated interest in industries served by TransUnion, such as financial services, insurance, fraud, and digital marketing (e.g., through relevant internships).
Strong analytical, critical thinking, and creative problem solving skills.
Advanced programming skill and aptitude; proficiency with statistical programs such as R or Python; experience with other programming and data manipulation languages (SQL, Hive, Spark, C/C++, Java, Ab Initio); high level of familiarity with Microsoft Office tools.
Versatile interpersonal and communication style with the ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels within and outside the organization; ability to work in a collaborative, fast-paced environment; evidence of initiative-taking.
Strong project and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple assignments effectively.
Interest in client-facing consulting roles and ability to travel 10-20%.

Preferred Skills

We’re also looking for the preferred skills below. Whether you are proficient or could use some brushing up, we’re happy to support your development in:

Proven ability to operate effectively under modest supervision in a complex and dynamic, matrixed environment.
Familiarity with credit bureau data and solutions.
Work experience in industries served by TransUnion, such as financial services, insurance, fraud, and digital marketing.

Benefits That Support Every Part Of Your Life

At TransUnion, we design benefits to help you feel well, do well, and plan well—from day one.

For Your Health
: Enjoy day-one eligibility for medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus supplemental plan options. Spousal, domestic partner, and other eligible dependent coverage is available on select plans. Choose tax‑advantaged HSA and FSA accounts to make everyday care more affordable.

For Your Protection
: We’ve got your back with company‑paid basic life and AD&D, optional voluntary life and AD&D for you and your family, and short‑ and long‑term disability. You can also opt into a legal plan, pet insurance, and travel accident coverage.

For Your Family
: From adoption assistance and fertility planning coverage to caregiver support, we’re here for every chapter. Access Dependent Care FSA for possibility of an employer match, a complimentary Care@Work membership, and up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave with eligibility for a thoughtful, gradual return.

For Your Future
: Build toward what’s next with our 401(k) with employer match and Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Tap financial wellness resources, career coaching, and optional long‑term care insurance to plan confidently.

For You
: Grow and recharge with tuition reimbursement, flexible time off for exempt employees or paid time off for nonexempt employees, up to 12 paid holidays per year, commuter benefits, employee discounts, charitable gift matching, and paid volunteer time off, plus corporate volunteer events that make it easy to give back.

For Your Wellness
: Access 24/7 support including professional therapy, coaching, and emotional well‑being programs alongside guided meditation and resources that support physical, mental, social, and financial wellness.

We are committed to being a place where diversity is not only present, it is embraced. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability status, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law. Additionally, in accordance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, TransUnion takes affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified individuals with a disability and protected veterans in all levels of employment and develops annual affirmative action plans. Components of TransUnion’s Affirmative Action Program for individuals with disabilities and protected veterans are available for review to any associate or applicant for employment upon request by contacting ERCoE@transunion.com.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act.

Adherence to Company policies, sound judgment and trustworthiness, working safely, communicating respectfully, and safeguarding business operations, confidential and proprietary information, and the Company’s reputation are also essential expectations of this position.

Pay Scale Information

The U.S. base salary range for this position is $67,500.00 - $112,500 annually. *The salary range for this position reflects a reasonable estimate of the range of compensation for this job. At TransUnion, actual compensation is based on careful consideration of additional factors such as (but not limited to) an individual’s education, training, work experience, job-related skill set, location, and industry knowledge, as well as the scope and responsibilities of the position and market considerations. Regular, fulltime non-sales positions may be eligible to participate in TransUnion’s annual bonus plan. Certain positions may be also eligible for long-term incentives and other payments based on applicable company guidance and plan documents.

TransUnion Overview

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our Workforce for Good
, which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.

Be a part of our Workforce for Good
– you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.
